titulo.alumno: An explicit cause · Cause, consequence and concession

intro: Part 1: an explicit cause. Read the heading and find the detail that answers the question.

frases.estudio: Værkstedet er lukket, fordi ejeren er syg.
frases.alumno: The workshop is closed because the owner is ill.

frases.estudio: Derfor må kunderne bestille en ny tid.
frases.alumno: That is why the customers have to book a new appointment.

texto: «Fordi» introduces a cause with a clause; «derfor» presents a consequence and, when it opens a main clause, triggers inversion. «Selvom» presents a difficulty that does not invalidate the main idea.
